college_info.college_name: Mahatma Gandhi University, Tura- Khanapara Campus

highlights.summary: Mahatma Gandhi University, Tura- Khanapara Campus, is located in Meghalaya. Established in 2011, it is a private university. Mahatma Gandhi University, Tura- Khanapara Campus provides 18 UG and PG courses in 2 specialisations, namely English and Public Administration. Theses programmes are offered in Full Time mode. MBA/PGDM, MCA, BCA, B.Com and B.A. are some of the courses offered at Mahatma Gandhi University, Tura- Khanapara Campus. Some of the streams in which these courses are offered include Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Accounting & Commerce, Law and Humanities & Social Sciences. The total fee at Mahatma Gandhi University, Tura- Khanapara Campus ranges between INR 72,000 to 2,20,000. Mahatma Gandhi University, Tura- Khanapara Campus offers all the infrastructural facilities to students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: I am absolutely dissatisfied.

review_content.Placements: Do not know yet about placements, as the college has not announced it. The highest package may be 20 LPA, not confirmed though. In our college, no companies come for recruitment. Many good students of our college get internships i.e., about 10 percent of students. I am not aware of the top roles offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is not available. Only 1 lab is decent, and the library is not open for students 24/7. There is no hostel as such. Only 3 or 4 students live in the hostel. I have not seen it yet, I do not eat canteen food, but it seems decent. Sports and game facilities are not available. Regarding medical facilities, they do have them, but not a specialist assigned to do so.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Great faculty members and good campus.

review_content.Placements: Many students get placements in college. College will provide internships for students to learn and gather information from their fields of study. Faculty provides the course to students to complete their course and to upgrade their skills.
review_content.Infrastructure: All the labs, library, and classrooms are neat and clean at all times. The canteen is also neat and clean. Canteen provides most of the food items to its students. All the rooms, labs, library, classroom, etc., are neat and clean.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Review of Vivekananda College of Technology and Management.

review_content.Placements: In our college, almost 60% of students are placed. The highest salary package offered is 4 LPA to 5 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 1.2 LPA. The average salary package offered is 2.3 PA to 2.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies like IBM, Wipro, Hero, Electric, etc., visit our campus. Internships are not available.
review_content.Infrastructure: Our college has excellent infrastructure. All students have access to labs, a library, and Wi-Fi for educational purposes. The hostel at our college is not very good, but it is still better than that provided by other colleges in the city. The mess food is good quality. The canteen, sports, and games are available. Medical facilities are available.

reviews_list.batch_info: Diploma in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2020
reviews_list.review_title: A college with good study environment and good infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Review of College of Engineering and Technology, Bikaner.

content.Placements: Around 2-3 students got placed in our batch. The highest salary package offered is 5 LPA. MNCs don't visit our college to recruit students. Small companies visit our college to recruit students.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is not much good. It is an old college. We don't have a canteen. The computer science department is not good. They don't give restrictions. The food served in the mess is good. The hostel facilities are good.
content.Faculty: Our teachers are not helpful. Some teachers are good. A few teachers don't have teaching skills. They don't conduct exams on time. The course curriculum is not relevant. It doesn't make students industry-ready. Semester exams are not difficult. The pass percentage is 40%.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied with this college because of its low placement rate and low salary packages.

content.Placements: Almost 90% of students got placed off-campus. Companies have not visited our college for internships. We need to hustle and get internships and jobs. The highest salary off-campus package offered ranges between 6 LPA - 7 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 3 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi on campus as well in the hostel. Sports facilities are average. The quality of the food in the mess is average. Medical facilities are not available in our college. Many books are available in the library which is necessary for the course. We can borrow books from the library. The hostel rooms are average. Girls hostel is 12 km away from our college. The boys' college is on campus.

individual_reviews.title: Review of College of Engineering and Technology, Bikaner.

content.Infrastructure: Hostel life was good. There was no Wi-Fi. The quality of the mess food was average. Sports facilities were not available, except for cricket. There were also private hostel facilities near the campus with the same fee and better facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: The college provides good satisfaction in placements.

content.Placements: If you are doing video then you do not get placement in BDS and in that we get clinical jobs and we can earn as much as you want from our own clinic. It is not that no one gets it. If we think of getting a job in it then we can easily get a job in any hospital or college but we do not get that much money in it.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel is quite good and classrooms are also good. The library is also available. Restaurants are also good and I think the food here is also okay. Security is taken care of in the hostel. There are CCTV cameras all around and ragging does not take place here. The campus is completely ragging-free and has a separate basketball court. A gym is also available for dental students.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharm) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of Index Institute of Pharmacy.

content.Placements: 60% marks in 10+2 in the science stream make students eligible for this course. The average package is 2 to 2.5 LPA. They provide placements at companies like TCS, Sun Pharma, and Cipla. They are also providing scholarships. The top roles are in the QA, QC and other departments .
content.Infrastructure: In this college, there are large campus facilities and a large department of pharmacy, and all the faculty are highly qualified and experienced. Free Wi-Fi networks are available for study. A large library area and hostel facilities are available and food and its quality are good. They conduct yearly sports and extracurricular activities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: The college is average, but there are no extra facilities.

content.Placements: Our college does not provide placements. A one-year internship is mandatory for all students after completing the course. The medical college does not give placements. This is the only disadvantage of choosing a medical field. After finishing the course, you must decide what to do next for yourself.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has excellent facilities and infrastructure. The hostel mess food is not good. The campus is good, but it is outside the city. Our hostel rooms are good, but no extra facilities are provided like Wi-Fi, coolers, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Dental Surgery (BDS) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: I am not satisfied because of its faculty members and infrastructure.

content.Placements: Placements were not provided at our college. In this course, students lack the necessary practical knowledge and skills required to do clinical practice.
content.Infrastructure: Our infrastructure was not good. The food served at the hostel was not decent. The library was good. Wi-Fi was not available on campus.
content.Faculty: Our professors were very helpful and knowledgeable. Our course curriculum was relevant. The semester exams were moderate. The professional exams were conducted very well.

individual_reviews.course: MBBS - Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: College is good. I'm satisfied by faculty and placements. Really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: 250 students are there in our batch. And college has its own university. Courses offered by college are MBBS, BDS dental, nursing, physiotherapy, pharmacy, B.A.M.S. Ayur-Veda college and hotel management was progressing now. Students got internship.
content.Infrastructure: Department was good. Lab was full of new apparatus. Classrooms are also good. Teaching by PPT slide share or by blackboard is the good medium for better understanding of topic. Canteen is present inside the college like Nescafe. Mess food is not oily.

college_info.intro: Medhavi Skills University popular programmes are BTech Computer Science Engineering, BSc Hospitality & Hotel Management, MBA, BBA, BCA, BPharm, BSc Biotechnology, and BSc Nursing. The university follows an Industry-Led Learning Model and hence provides practical learning opportunities to students. The university is known to offer on the job training opportunities to students. The university focuses on a competency-based evaluation process rather than purely theoretical examinations. The college provides scholarships to students which ensures that all students have equal opportunity to complete their education at this university. BTech students can become Engineers and can also join various top companies at top positions. Below mentioned are some of the Medhavi Skills University courses and their respective eligibility and Medhavi Skills University fee:

faqs.answer: A:    The Industry-Led Learning Model at the Medhavi Skills University is an approach to education and training that aligns academic programmes with the knowledge, skills, and competencies demanded by industries. It emphasizes collaboration between educational institutions and industry partners to create a curriculum, provide hands-on experience, and foster employability.
faqs.question: What is the Industry Led Learning Model at Medhavi Skills University?

faqs.answer: A:    Medhavi Skill University MSc eligibility criteria is merit-based. To be eligible for admission into this course, students must have completed a BSc in Biotechnology/ Biochemistry/ Microbiology/ Botany/ Zoology/ Life Sciences/ Biomedical Sciences/ Chemistry or BPharm. The degree must be from a recognised institute/ university. Further, students need to appear for MSAT. Eligible students can apply online for the course by filling out the application form.
faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for MSc at Medhavi Skills University?

faqs.answer: A:    Medhavi Skills University admission is primarily merit-based. However, students need to sit for the Medhavi Scholarship and Aptitude Test (MSAT). Further, if required, the university may conduct additional selection rounds, such as personal interviews. It is important that students fulfil the minimum educational qualification of the desired course to be eligible for admission. Aspirants can apply online at the official website of the university.
faqs.question: Can I join Medhavi Skills Univeristy without entrance exam?

Post graduate course in Marketing Management is known as MBA in Marketing. Generally, specialisation in marketing management is offered in the second year of MBA courses. reviews.review_heading: It is a nice place to build our career.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. The network connection is quite poor, to be honest. We have library facilities. Our college conducts tournaments every year for all sports. Inter-college matches are available for all sports. The canteen food is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Good college and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was good for a engineering college. ATM and a bank inside the college. There was a garden that contained a good space for entertainment. Labs were spacious and had a good number of pc. Classrooms were spacious and digitally updated. The hostel was good. Mess food was average. There was a cricket ground volleyball court badminton court and indoor playground available.

reviews.review_heading: Puducherry Technological University.
reviews.review_text: Hostel life is very good. The food is a little bit average because most of the dishes are south indian, but the taste is very decent and much better than the other college hostel and mess. You can request the menu change as the menu is decided by the students only.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfactory college with decent faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: Campus has a central Wi-Fi that works all over the campus. The campus is also very big. Library has more than 8,000 books on all streams of engineering. Classrooms are decent.

reviews.review_heading: Campus life and hostel life are good.
reviews.review_text: In the hostel, the in and out timings are okay, but the food is typical South Indian and below average. Electricity is there most of the time, but it goes off during heavy rain. Still, there is a generator for power backup. Wi-Fi facility is good, but mobile internet is not there.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good for day scholars but not for hostellers.
reviews.review_text: There is no Wi-Fi in the classrooms, but Wi-Fi in the hostel rooms is free. The hostel food is not good yet, and no canteen for hostellers. There are no medical facilities after 5 PM. Sports and games are there, but at night, there are no students on the ground after 7:00 PM, and there is no lighting facility on the ground.

reviews.review_heading: College has a good ground facility.
reviews.review_text: College has a gym facility but its access is allowed only to hostellers. It has a decent canteen facility. The campus will be open from 9:00 AM- 6:00 PM. College ground is the place I hang out the most and the locality is safe.

reviews.review_heading: In my college, the education is affordable with good value.
reviews.review_text: Every student will be given a library passbook for the purpose of borrowing books. Sports events are conducted for every sport annually for all departments and the overall champion is chosen.

reviews.review_heading: You can have memories and friends, but they don't offer proper placements.
reviews.review_text: There are no proper classrooms for both students and staff. The hostel is in the worst condition. There is no quality food and water. The building is too old. The library is a good place to read and spend some useful time in our college. The canteen is so good and for six months once we used to conduct sports event without fails.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good college for M.Tech.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities were not good. There was no network for Jio users, and the Wi-Fi stopped working every once in a while. Preparation was not done quickly. The food was not great. Non-veg was provided three times a week, and sometimes the food was good, while other times it was bad. It was a little cheaper compared to staying at rented places. Restrooms were not very clean. Overall, the hostel facilities were not good.

reviews.review_heading: My honest review on the college.
reviews.review_text: The syllabus will be updated every three years for every course conducted in the university. Course curriculum will cope with the demands of the changing world. Also, for master students, there was an option for choosing soft core courses from other departments to get more credit. Hostel could provide a good environment for the students. In the hostel, four students could share one room. The meal quality was average in the hostel. The hostel cost was little expensive. Overall, the hostel facilit...

reviews.review_heading: It is a gateway to a wonderful journey and success.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided by the college are fantastic. There is free Wi-Fi throughout the campus but in some areas, there is restricted access. Classrooms are neat and spacious. There is a good environment to study. I am a day scholar, so I do not know much about the hostel but my friends said it is very normal with average food. The availability of food in the canteen and mess is super. There are medical facilities, sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: PTU (PEC) - (Student review).
reviews.review_text: College has not done proper renovation and less maintenance services. Wi-Fi is present across each department with low connectivity. Library is outdated and some books are in bad condition. Canteen has less ventilation and decent food is available. The sports ground and equipments are present separately. There is a small complex present for students, staffs, and hostel students. There is a small dispensary and medical equipment with an ambulance.

reviews.review_heading: Still in developing stage, bad placements, bad infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure in this college is still in the developing stage. Classrooms are not equipped with digital equipment or any Wi-Fi requirements. The library is very outdated. Labs are very old and equipped with very old equipment. The hostel is also very basic which is frequently disrupted by water and Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: PEC college review by a 3rd year student .
reviews.review_text: When it comes to infrastructure, it is good that you will get decent old-fashioned classroom sets with outdated syllabi. Even the labs aren't modern; they use very old machines. Hostels are decent, but the food is not so good. There is an immediate medical team inside the campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is good for living the best college life.

content.Placements: 0.01 % of students get placements from the college campus. No companies visit the college to recruit students from this course only. content.Infrastructure: The college is good, but there is no development. The hostel is good for boys and not for girls, due to the outer area. Labs are only for seeing and not for gaining information or for developing skills. Only a few digital classrooms are available here.

individual_reviews.title: Placements were good in 2019, and the infrastructure is really good.

content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of my building is also very well-structured. Hostel facilities are very helpful for our daily work. The taste of hostel food is delicious, cooked with a focus on hygiene, and they always make sure to clean the room.

reviews.review_heading: It is good for living the best college life.
reviews.review_text: The college is good, but there is no development. The hostel is good for boys and not for girls, due to the outer area. Labs are only for seeing and not for gaining information or for developing skills. Only a few digital classrooms are available here.

reviews.review_heading: Placements were good in 2019, and the infrastructure is really good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of my building is also very well-structured. Hostel facilities are very helpful for our daily work. The taste of hostel food is delicious, cooked with a focus on hygiene, and they always make sure to clean the room.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are good before Covid, average infrastructure, good facilities, and value for money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not bad; it is the same as shown on the website. The hostel life is also good and has good facilities like a library, Wi-Fi and computer labs. All labs have a good Wi-Fi network, which helps students, good medicine facilities, good food facilities, and average canteen food.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with the College but Satisfied with College Life.

reviews.review_heading: So it is okay. If you don't want to go outside your city, you can consider this college.
reviews.review_text: The hostel life is good. The buildings are fine, but since I am not a hostel student, I don't know much more. From the outside, it's average. The quality of food in the canteen is good, and the taste is awesome. The classrooms are average, but the fans don't work properly in the summer, and students struggle in the hot weather.

reviews.review_heading: Average college in Jhansi for engineering.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is not very good because it is old. There is no Wi-Fi facility provided to the students and the canteen is very bad because the price of the food items is too high. Sports are conducted twice a year. Also, the college is situated outside the city so there are not many facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SR Group of Institution (SRGI).
reviews.review_text: The structure of the hostel is average, and the course curriculum is intermediate. We all try to self-study all advanced topics. Professors are knowledgeable and supportive, making the course easy to understand, but it does not develop valuable skills for a future career and lacks the latest advancement due to limited resources.

reviews.review_heading: Reality behind engineering.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in college campus but we are unable to access it. For some special reasons only we able to access college Wi-Fi. The food provided by the college mess is not bad and we can eat that without any fear. The infrastructure is really good of the college and we can get a good environment in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college faculty members are excellent, and the college infrastructure is extensive.
reviews.review_text: Among the other buildings, B.Tech has the largest with the best infrastructure. Our department has good Wi-Fi with average speed. The library and classrooms are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Review of SR Group of Institution (SRGI).
reviews.review_text: We have a Wi-Fi facility with good internet speed. We have 6 labs, and each lab has Wi-Fi, printers, and scanners. There is a server room that handles all machines present in the 6 labs. Our college also has a library. There are projectors for presentations, workshops, and seminars. We have a great canteen.

reviews.review_heading: A short and descriptive review of our institute.
reviews.review_text:
Facilities of our institute is too good and their infrastructure liked by everyone. They maintain their respect among all the comers. Wi-Fi, proper labs, library is present in our institute 
Much sports are available in our institute, here you can explore your sports skills. Medical and canteen facilities is also available, even Medical facilities is available 24*7 in our institute. Hostel facilities is superb in our institute.

reviews.review_heading: There are no placements in the college.
reviews.review_text: Our library is good with a huge collection of books. The facilities and infrastructure are average. The classrooms are spacious, but the infrastructure is average. Our college events are really good with all types of events, from sports to educational.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is a good option.
reviews.review_text: All are good. Wi-Fi is average. Library is quite big. Many assignments and projects are offered. Two canteens and lots of games are available. Campus is very good.

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best colleges in Jhansi.
reviews.review_text: The faculty in our college is good. They have qualifications like a PhD. We have one of the best faculties. The hostel is also good. There are many games and sports organised throughout the college. This is a good college for engineering in Jhansi.

reviews.review_heading: It is an excellent college with good faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good quality IT lab and training teachers. Air-conditioners are working all the time. Every classroom has a projector and professional faculty.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharma.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the college was really good.

content.Placements: No placement has been done by the college. Not a single company or organisation or any startups came for jobs and placements. Also, they have other courses like BCA. The reason for this is just because the college is located out of the city, in a small village.
content.Infrastructure: No Wi-Fi is provided by the college. Also, there is no proper internet connection near the college. The hostel is good. The hostel is located in the main city. Veg and non-veg food are both available in the hostel mess.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college has a good value for money for students who cannot afford education.

content.Placements: Almost 70% of students have been recruited by companies such as Wipro, Infosys, and TCS. Top roles offered are software developer, website designer, and graphics designer.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel provides beds for all students. All beds are arranged in a huge room and there is no privacy. Wi-Fi facility is not available in the hostel. A library is available with a good number of books, and it is a good place to study. The food served in the mess is good. A volleyball court is available outside the hostel, where hostel students play in the evening.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It has good faculty and infrastructure with good facilities.

content.Placements: There were 21 students in the batch. Almost everyone has a job, such as web design, owning their own business, or teaching in their field. The salary offered was Rs. 20000 per month to Rs. 25000 per month. 3 out of 21 students got internships from the course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was very simple. They provided hostel facilities at a very low cost. The quality of facilities in the hostel was very good and hygienic. The quality of the food was average. A canteen was available.
content.Faculty: The teachers were very helpful, well qualified and knowledgeable. They teach about current scenarios, like Linux and its tools. The teaching quality is very good. The course curriculum makes students industry-ready. Students should give their effort because they can only teach, and students have to learn. The semester exam at this college is not difficult. The minimum passing percentage is 40%.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. B.Ed. - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Life and career at MAUJ Jodhpur.

content.Placements: There is about 60% students gets immediate placement after that degree The placement packages are low because teaching jobs are not highly paying it can vary 10000 to 15000 approximately Top recruiter are private schools of our city The top role is a teacher.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is quite impressive and it's located outside our city so there are very calm and clean environment, we have well-equipped labs and classroom with proper sitting The hostel has not fully developed so there is no impressive service are there.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college is good, and they provide good placements.

content.Placements: Almost 99% of students got placed in our college. The highest salary package offered was 5 LPA. The lowest salary package offered was 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were TCS, Wipro, Tata, Infosys, Aditya Birla Group, Utkarsh Small Finance Bank, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college was good. Our college had air-conditioning and Wi-Fi facilities. Laboratories were well-maintained. Laboratories, the library, and classrooms were air-conditioned. The campus was spread over five acres of land. All facilities were good.

reviews.review_text: The facilities provided by the college is very good and they understand the students need. They have a very good library with a good collection of updated books. We are able to prepare for other exams as well. This college provides a good platform for development.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing college to study MBA.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is very good. They provide all required resources with a good library and Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms. Our library is stocked with all updated books which help us study for semester exams and even prepare for competitive exams. Overall, it is good.

reviews.review_heading: A very good place to study an MBA with opportunities for growth.
reviews.review_text: Our classroom environment is conducive. There is a library. We have Wi-Fi enabled classrooms. They provide much support for extra-curricular activities. The library is equipped with all the resources needed for MBA students. It provides an ideal platform for overall development.

reviews.review_heading: It is a very good place to pursue an MBA.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and library are good. Facilities and infrastructure have greatly enhanced my learning experience. Classes are well-ventilated and equipped. The library has an extensive collection of books and journals. I am thoroughly impressed with the facilities provided here.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive staffs and excellent place to study MBA.
reviews.review_text: MBA industry integrated course is framed in a way that we can enhance our knowledge in different fields which is very much needed in present job market. The facilities provided for MBA students for the course is very good and supportive for us. The resource they provide are very helpful.
